context: Two athletes review their training plan together
purpose: Teach: コーチ/狙っ/天才/回数/アルバイト/チャンネル/加速/盛ん

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: サクラ、コーチがくれた今月の練習メニュー、もう目を通した？
lines.en: Sakura, did you look at the training menu Coach gave us this month?
lines.style: Casual upward inflection, friendly senior tone, slightly tired evening voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うん、見たよ。先輩、今月は短距離の回数がかなり増えてるよね。
lines.en: Yeah, I saw it. Senpai, the number of sprint reps has really jumped this month.
lines.style: Bright teen energy, respectful toward senpai, slight worry in pitch.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 全国大会を狙ってるから、後半に加速できる脚を作りたいらしい。
lines.en: Apparently he wants legs that can accelerate in the last stretch since we're aiming for nationals.
lines.style: Steady explanatory tone, focused, lowered volume like in a locker room.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: なるほど。でも私、夕方からアルバイトもあるし、両立きついなあ。
lines.en: I see. But I've got my part-time job in the evenings too, so juggling both is rough.
lines.style: Half-complaining sigh, dropping pitch at the end, candid teen honesty.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: わかる。最近うちの大学、陸上が盛んでライバルも増えたしね。
lines.en: I get it. Track has gotten really popular at our uni lately, and rivals are everywhere.
lines.style: Sympathetic college-aged tone, casual sentence-end particle, warm.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: そういえば、コーチがYouTubeチャンネルで自分のフォーム見て研究しろって。
lines.en: Oh right, Coach told us to study our own form on his YouTube channel.
lines.style: Sudden remembered thought, excited rising tone, talkative teen rhythm.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: あの人、教え方が天才的だから素直に従ったほうがいいよ。
lines.en: That guy is a genius at coaching, so we'd better just follow what he says.
lines.style: Mild laugh in voice, admiring tone, soft chuckle on the final word.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: じゃあバイト減らして、練習回数を週五に増やしてみる！
lines.en: Okay then, I'll cut back on the part-time job and bump practice up to five times a week!
lines.style: Decisive teen resolve, brightening voice, slight fist-pump energy.
